description.text: Objectives: This program trains students with principles of economic theories, basic theories of international economy and trade. They are also required to master basic knowledge and skills of international trade, international economy and trade regulations, economic policies in the different countries. After graduating, students are expected to have the ability to work on management, investigation, research, overseas-funded enterprises, and governmental institutions. Objects: Four-year Bachelor of Economics Degree Main Courses: Political Economics, Micro-Economics, Macro-Economics, World Economy, Calculative Economics, Accounting, Statistics, Basic Course of Computer, International Trade, Practical Import and Export, Theory and Policy of WTO, International Market Marketing, Economics, International Finance, International Business Law, Monetary and Banking, E-Commerce, Network Technique, and English Course for International Trade etc.

duration.text: The International Economy and Trade at Nanjing Audit University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
